CustomField.description: Display score. For Apex Tests the score is the code coverage percentage; other tools use the first available success, failure, or skipped count.
CustomField.formula: IF( NOT(ISBLANK(copado__Coverage__c)), SUBSTITUTE(TEXT(copado__Coverage__c), "%", "") & " (Coverage %)", IF( NOT(ISBLANK(copado__Success_Count__c)), TEXT(copado__Success_Count__c), IF( NOT(ISBLANK(copado__Failure_Count__c)), TEXT(copado__Failure_Count__c) & " (violations)", IF( NOT(ISBLANK(copado__Skipped_Count__c)), TEXT(copado__Skipped_Count__c), "" ) ) ) )
CustomField.label: Score
